description: Search the Pocket Network agentic marketplace: pay-per-request data services and utilities (blockchain data, research, web, finance and more). Free. Describe what you need in plain words: results are ranked best first. Returns ids, one-line descriptions and prices; call describe_service before calling one.

category.description: Exact category, e.g. research. The result lists them all.

limit.description: Default 20, at most 500. `total` says how many there are.

query.description: What you need, in plain words. Every service matching any of them is returned, best match first, with the words it matched. Omit to list the catalogue.

name: search_services
title: Search Pocket Network services
